name: ETL Instacart Data to Amazon Redshift
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select Instacart as the data source.
2.  Select your added Amazon Redshift data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorise DataChannel to connect to your Instacart account with any Name, Application UID and Application Secret.
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/apollo/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
